[The son is on a mission, the father is imprisoned in a basement. And there is only one week. Can Shekhar save both? His father and Mumbai? To watch the full story, come to the English Seekho app today and watch Jasoos Teacher. Also, learn English like Shekhar on the same app with proper teachers. Trial for ₹1. Start tonight.] Speaker E: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
